slides.title: You have a bar.
slides.body: Not a favourite bar. Your bar. You know it by the tape and the slight wobble.

slides.title: You know the playlist.
slides.body: You can tell how much warm-up is left by which song is on.

slides.title: You read the whiteboard's mood.
slides.body: One glance and you know whether coach slept well.

slides.title: You have a spot.
slides.body: Back left corner. Someone new stood there once. You still think about it.

slides.title: You warn the new people.
slides.body: Quietly. About the wall balls. And the rower on the end.

slides.title: Your PRs are legends now.
slides.body: The 2021 deadlift comes up weekly. The details improve every time.
